tasks.label: dev server
tasks.detail: ng serve on http://localhost:4200, after build-env.sh wrote src/assets/env.js. Leaves a server that already holds the port alone. Runs on node 22.23.3 from nvm when it is installed, because the Angular CLI refuses some newer versions; where that path does not exist the default node is used.
tasks.command: if curl -sfo /dev/null --max-time 2 http://localhost:4200/; then echo 'Local: http://localhost:4200/ is already served, nothing started'; else npm run start_dev; fi
